Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time on the renewal call yesterday. To keep the renewal and the additional capacity request moving, I wanted to hand off the procurement portal steps and surface a couple items that need alignment before we kick legal/finance.

Quick summary of asks:
- We need portal admin access for your procurement team (Procurement Team <procurement@acme-robotics.com>).
- Confirm whether Acme will accept the 12-month term with the phased capacity increase (month 1: baseline, month 4: +25%, month 8: +25%).
- Two checkbox items for your security side (I cc'd Marcus for the SOC/Security packet): confirmation of KMS key management and data locality (US).

I've attached the onboarding checklist and a one-page SOW amendment that reflects the staged capacity. Once you confirm, we'll open a DocuSign envelope and push the portal invitation (link below).

Portal invite (placeholder): https://procure.acme-robotics.com/onboard?token=eyJhbGci
HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.ai/hubspot/deal/RDW-2026-0421

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD Monday so finance has time to prepare the PO lanes?

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
<aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Susan / Aisha —

Quick answers from the security team:
- KMS: We can support customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations. I'll attach the short tech matrix for key rotation and ownership.
- Data residency: We will provision Acme's instances in our US region (us-west-2) and can add contract language to the SOW making that a contractual obligation.

On the committed capacity question: the baseline for the 12-month term will be 32 vCPU-equivalent tokens and a burst reserve for the staged months. For PO purposes, if you prefer a single committed ceiling, let's set the committed ceiling at the month-8 level (+50% from baseline). That will simplify invoicing and PO language.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aisha to upload a redline-friendly SOW (word) and the PO-ready quantitative annex.
2) We'll send the DocuSign for the SOW amendment once procurement confirms admin emails.
3) Ben will create the portal admin invites once we have the admin list.

Marcus Lin
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
